definition: [ דָּפַק ] verb beat, knock (Arabic pour out , also drive (beasts)) — Qal Perf. 3 masculine plural suffix וּדְפָקוּם consecutive Gen 33:13 , but read 1 singular suffix וּדְפַקְתִּים ᵐ5 ᵑ6 Sam Di beat (in driving, drive severely or cruelly); Participle דּוֺפֵק Song 5:2 absolute knocking (at door). Hithpa`el Participle מִתְדַּפְּקִים עַלהַֿדָּ֑לֶת Judg 19:22 beat violently (beat themselves tired) against the door.

Hithpa`el Participle מִתְדַּפְּקִים עַלהַֿדָּ֑לֶת Judg 19:22 beat violently (beat themselves tired) against the door.
